value.rationale: This proves a specifically posed center-limit and uniqueness question for the standard regularly varying Weibull class, strengthens radius asymptotics to a joint geometric statistic, and yields a natural complete full-simplex support classification in every fixed dimension. The random active-set lemma is necessary structural content, not a renaming or a moment corollary. The theorem gives meaningful information even without an explicit density or rates.
